fact: A joint study by the Mediator institution, the ONDH and the Secretariat of State for Social Inclusion, presented in March 2026, found only 47.5% of public institutions offer inclusive digital solutions and 25% of administrations are inclusive overall.

UN ESCWA and Morocco's Agency of Digital Development held a national workshop in Rabat on 18 July 2024 to develop a national plan for digital accessibility, discussing the development phases of the e-Accessibility plan.

An IJICT journal study based on interviews with Moroccan public-sector web developers and IT managers reports a lack of legal framework and available guidelines as a barrier to web accessibility in public e-services.

HACA's decision 50-26 of 16 June 2026 requires audiovisual services to guarantee persons with disabilities access to election-period programmes, by sign language, subtitling or audio description where the programme allows.

The digital transition ministry says it launched a new version of the national Idarati portal whose navigation, search and content were redesigned for digital accessibility, with particular attention to persons with disabilities.
